limits: Short loaded fixtures use labeled diagnostic padding.
The calendar scenarios use scheduled samples across 22 sessions. They do not model all packets for 22 full trading days.
CPU affinity and a sampled RSS ceiling do not reproduce Docker CPU quota, cross-UID restrictions, or connected market or model latency.
A recovered native acknowledgement timeout counts as a failed deadline even if both fills are verified.
The p95 engineering headroom target is five seconds from the original quote source to an approved opening reservation. A session with no openings is unmeasured.
